mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO workflow_run_event_cursor (tenant_id, user_id, run_id, trace_id, next_sequence, revision) SELECT tenant_id, user_id, run_id, trace_id, 1, 0 FROM chat_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND source_type IN ('workflow', 'agent') AND trace_id IS NOT NULL AND trace_id <> '' AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, user_id, run_id, trace_id, next_sequence, terminal_event_type, terminal_sequence, revision FROM workflow_run_event_cursor WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_run_event_cursor SET next_sequence = next_sequence + 1, revision = revision + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND trace_id = #{traceId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE intelligent_workflow_run SET next_sequence = #{nextSequence}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND trace_id = #{traceId} AND next_sequence < #{nextSequence} AND deleted = 0
